lineage.st6_result: Frozen developmental compositional transfer Brier .0001 matching same-information symbolic selector; unseen operator Brier .42885; retained gain 100%; not independent scientific pass

hypothesis: A bounded tokenless eight-output causal operator learner can infer unknown 36-feature quadratic Boolean causal law coefficients from authentic action-consequence data, then transfer to unfamiliar A,B combinations without being told any correct operator list or private coefficient. Must be compared with fully trained exact same-capacity conventional GF(2) polynomial solver; matching conventional baseline is NOT unique native intelligence.

source.actor: Five ACTUAL private-source actions [3,0,1,2,3]. First neutral step reveals environmental rotation r; action0 reveals A; action1 reveals B; action2 schedules a private one-step delayed effect g(A,B); final neutral action3 reveals the delayed causal consequence. All models predict before each action, observe actual public changed bits after world.step; never receive private law ID/seed/trial, coefficients, rule ID, delayed target, source object, or a paired oracle.
source.masks: A=SHA256('ST7-a|'+law+'|'+seed+'|'+trial)[0], B=SHA256('ST7-b|'+law+'|'+seed+'|'+trial)[0]. Both vary across episodes, making causally identifying interventions span the possible action space.
source.start: Smallest nonce 0..255 for x0=SHA256('ST7-state|'+seed+'|'+trial+'|'+nonce)[0] with distinct ROTL(x0,1/2/3); no dependence on law or outcome.
source.true_rule: g(A,B)=A XOR f(B); f_j(B)=GF2 parity of 36 monomials: eight B bits and all 28 unordered products B_i AND B_k, i<k, each gated by one privately seeded binary coefficient. There are 8 output rows (288 private binary coefficients). No learner or conventional comparator receives those coefficients.
source.coefficient_custody: For j=0..7, coeff bit k is SHA256('ST7-rule|output='+j+'|feature='+k)[0]&1, shared across all TRAIN and HELD laws. This single private compositional rule is not revealed or enumerated inside either learner.
source.negative_rule: For disjoint NEGATIVE laws [43,47], coefficients instead SHA256('ST7-unknown-alternate|output='+j+'|feature='+k)[0]&1, and the effect additionally XORs cubic bitwise B & ROTL8(B,1) & ROTL8(B,2). Models get no negative-law signal. Negative evaluates lack of zero-shot transfer to a genuinely different unknown rule.

source_only_qualification.checks: TRAIN ONLY: verify 1,536 authentic complete five-action episodes and 7,680 real actions. All public diagnostic rotations/A/B exactly match private evaluator truth; 36 monomial feature columns have rank 36 over GF2, each output true coefficient row nonzero and at least 32 nonzero genuine second-order coefficients across 8 output rows; all train true target bits exactly generated by private polynomial. Require 8 distinct rotation/mask public world-law signatures from training records, no anomalous future label, cross-OS identical source/action SHA and rank. HELD/negative/interference law source outcomes unopened at this gate.
source_only_qualification.failure: SOURCE_UNIDENTIFIABLE_DEV_NO_GO; source law/seeds/coefficients do not change after stage0 output.

candidate.type: Native tokenless eight-cell integer linear-constraint memory. Public 36-monomial feature vector generated only from previously observed diagnostic B bits; eight output residual bits recovered AFTER genuine final consequence. Maintain 36 bounded augmented GF2 rows across eight output bits, incrementally XOR eliminating with fixed pivot order; no hardcoded correct rule, no list of candidate rule outputs, no gradient transformer/token architecture.
candidate.memory: Each augmented row encodes 36 feature bits plus 8 observed output bits, 36 rows of 44-bit unsigned integers; capacity physically at most 36*6=216 bytes packed, or 36*8=288 if 64-bit aligned. Persist 36 array rows, learned source ranks and step. Equal 36-row/44-bit evidence budget for exact conventional polynomial control. Count and checkpoint overhead separately.
candidate.cold: Exact JSON canonical snapshot/cold restoration on Linux+Windows and exact integer-state SHA continuity; models never receive source-private law identification.

controls: Independent fully trained 36-feature GF2 Gaussian elimination exact symbolic polynomial solver with same 36 augmented feature/output rows, same public data and episode budget. Must report parity/tie, never claim uniquely native benefit if tied.
Fully trained conventional 36-feature 8-output online logistic model with fixed 4 SGD updates per genuine final observation, matched information and disclosed weights/compute (not equal param count).
Frozen ST6 eight-hypothesis native selector unchanged; limited finite menu; no candidate operator explicit.
Linear-only ablation using 8 single-bit B features (no second-order interactions), matched number of source actions but smaller model; structural information/size difference disclosed.
No-B intervention ablation that treats diagnostic B bits as zero.
Episodic erase ablation clearing learned polynomial constraints between episodes.
Private source polynomial oracle for ceiling only; not admissible as model/control winner.

frozen_metrics.primary: Pooled 4 new-law x8 new-seed x16 new-trial genuine preaction final changed-bit Brier; <=0.02; each of four held laws <=0.04. ZERO training on held.
frozen_metrics.causal_ablation: Candidate Brier improves >=0.10 absolute over BOTH linear-only, no-B, erased, and ST6 finite-menu. Matched exact conventional GF2 solver candidate non-inferior within 0.01; ties explicitly reported.
frozen_metrics.negative: Two negative-rule laws x16 trials x5 actions, train=False: candidate Brier>=0.10 and report exact poor transfer to a different polynomial/cubic rule. Never retune from this result.
frozen_metrics.retention: Original TRAIN law 3, seed100, trials16; test preaction probe with train=False before+after fitting eight unrelated SAME-rule interference laws; >=95% chance-corrected previously learned gain retained, <=0.02 absolute Brier deterioration, no original rehearsal on recall. This is retention of one globally shared operator, NOT independent memory of eight different laws.
frozen_metrics.engineering: Single Linux trained artifact reused byte-identically by Linux and Windows, source-action SHA parity, native integer-state exact chain, scores equal <=1e-12, actual source/learner costs recorded, whole source+actor+training+eval modeled wall ratio <=1.5x fastest fully trained same-information GF2 or logistic control on BOTH OS, independent G29 full final separate.
